title: Fryrvo Discs
description: Add music by Fryrvo as Music Disc
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1840b0d87ff8af80d403bd06bc6bdda79fc8be5e.jpeg) # Fryrvo Discs **Add more Music Discs to your game**
**_This mod adds custom music discs tracks By Fryrvo to the game_** ### All Current Music Discs ![All Current Music Discs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/407dff96f34cb775a34c4bc6e4b098d5a5d31319.png) ### Detail * **Mod Loader:** Fabric * **Latest Versions:** 1.21.8–1.21.11 * **Dependencies:** Fabric API ### How to Obtain * **Survival:** Currently UnObtainable in Survival * **Creative:** "Tools & Utilities" creative tab. #### Current Music List
Music List * **[Fryrvo - Dream](https://youtu.be/n1xaPIOeGOQ?si=i9rY6xe-LioIyDRA)**
* **[Fryrvo - Star](https://youtu.be/tA9Kk33Ftfg?si=exG8f985FaywANww)**
* **[Fryrvo - WanderLust](https://youtu.be/d_pUZ_5SnYw?si=xkH0St-cIwlZWD67)**
